request.question: On the attention runtime benchmark, what speedups over FlashAttention in Triton are reported separately for the forward and backward passes, and on what GPU?

result.question: On the attention runtime benchmark, what speedups over FlashAttention in Triton are reported separately for the forward and backward passes, and on what GPU?

papers.candidate_answer: FlashAttention-2 is 1.3-1.5× faster than FlashAttention in Triton in the forward pass and 2× faster in the backward pass on the A100 GPU.

paper_assignment.title: FlashAttention-2: Faster Attention with Better Parallelism and Work Partitioning

evidence.title: FlashAttention-2: Faster Attention with Better Parallelism and Work Partitioning
evidence.quote:
28). We report the results in Fig. 4, Fig. 5 and Fig. 6, showing that FlashAttention-2 is around 2×\times faster than FlashAttention and FlashAttention in xformers (the “cutlass” implementation). FlashAttention-2 is around 1.3-1.5×\times faster than FlashAttention in Triton in the forward pass and around 2×\times faster in the backward pass. Compared to a standard attention implementation in PyTorch, FlashAttention-2 can be up to 10×\times faster.

Benchmark setting: we vary the sequence length
